svg.title: Travian Kingdoms support reply — browser and mobile refund requirements
svg.desc: The support team asks where the Gold was purchased. For browser purchases they request a transaction picture; for Apple App Store they direct buyers to Report a Problem; for Google Play Store they request an invoice with a GPA order number.

g.text: Have you purchased Gold in Travian Kingdoms through the browser version or the App (iOS or
For the browser version, could you please send us a picture of the transaction?
Unfortunately, for Apple Store, we do not have information about payments made through the App
Store, even though we are sellers. You should contact the App Store support team using the
"Report a Problem" button when viewing payment details in the App Store and request a refund.
For Google Play Store, please send us an invoice to see your order number (for example,
GPA.1234-5678-5432-9876). The order number can be found when viewing payment details on
